narrative.northStar: The National Forensic Light-Table & Statutory Comparator Workbench
narrative.overview: Veritas is built for high-consequence regulatory scrutiny under the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) Approval Process Handbook (APH 2024–2027). Rather than treating document validation as a generic SaaS dashboard with decorative gauges or opaque AI scores, Veritas divides the workspace into two physically grounded zones: a warm alabaster Statutory Dossier Ledger (#F5F4F0) for reading multi-document checklists and consistency tables under bright office lighting, and a calibrated dark Optical Inspection Chamber (#10141A / #0D1117) for inspecting high-DPI PDF certificates, Error Level Analysis (ELA) heatmaps, SIFT copy-move vectors, and computer-vision bounding boxes without glare.
keyCharacteristics: Dual-zone polarity pairing warm statutory paper (#F5F4F0) with a dark optical comparator chamber (#10141A).
Zero-radius (0px) rectilinear precision with 1px hairline structural borders across all panels, tables, and controls.
Orthogonal SVG cross-lock tethers connecting decoded QR code payloads directly to conflicting printed OCR spans on the document specimen.
Live parameter calibration sliders (JPEG Q, GAIN, ELA MIX) driving real-time OpenCV recompression overlays alongside a monospaced (X, Y) cursor coordinate readout.
Deliberate spatial isolation and outline-until-focused gating on adverse deficiency / show-cause actions.

rules.name: The Evidentiary Signal Rule
rules.body: Saturated red, amber, and teal inks never appear as decorative accents; they appear only when tied to a specific forensic measurement, APH clause check, or source API status, always paired with a geometric prefix glyph (●, ▲, ◆, ○).

rules.name: The Dual-Zone Polarity Rule
rules.body: Text-heavy checklists and statutory tables live on warm alabaster paper (#F5F4F0); pixel-level document specimens, ELA heatmaps, and CV bounding boxes live inside the dark optical chamber (#10141A).

rules.name: The Tabular Measurement Rule
rules.body: Every numeric readout—intake counts, carpet area in sq.m, Haversine GPS distance, ELA error levels, and confidence scores—uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so columns and live slider readouts never jitter.

rules.name: The Hairline Seam Rule
rules.body: Panels, metric cells, and checklist rows divide with 1px solid borders (#D5D2C8 on paper, #262E3B in the chamber), never with floating card shadows or thick colored side stripes.

dos: Do co-reference every checklist flag and consistency row to a concrete bounding box on the right-hand Optical Stage.
Do pair every semantic color state with a geometric prefix (●, ▲, ◆, ○) and explicit APH 2024–2027 clause or forensic metric.
Do isolate adverse regulatory actions (Confirm Deficiency / Show-Cause Flag) with empty space and outline-until-focused styling.
Do use monospace strictly for measurements, hashes, coordinates, timestamps, and certificate identifiers.
donts: Don't place uppercase eyebrow/kicker labels above headings (h1–h4).
Don't use thick (>1px) colored left or right border stripes on checklist rows, alerts, or containers.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism, gradient text, neon glows, or unanchored circular gauges.
Don't present AI forensic findings as automated rejections; always frame them as evidence-linked advisory indicators subject to human officer disposition.
